base.text:
Cry: Tribute one of your other Units and remember it.
Death: Summon {copies|copy|copies} of it.

radiant.text:
Cry: Tribute one of your other Units and remember it.
Death: Fill your board with copies of it.

base.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a ({costLimit}) Cost or less card, if you have an empty unit zone: Summon 2 Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

radiant.text: Reveals when your opponent plays a card, if you have an empty unit zone: Fill your board with Rush Tokens. If it's a Unit, they attack it.

base.text: Discover a card from your graveyard. It costs ({discount}) less. Exile this.

radiant.text: Discover a card from your graveyard. It costs ({setCost}). Exile this.

base.text:
Indestructible
Start of game: Gain one of 13 random powers. Each is an Activate that spends its (X).
(3) Expedition Map: Recruit a permanent.
(1) Life Tap: Draw {tapDraw}. Take {tapDamage} damage.
(1) Steady Shot: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero.
(2) Ranching: Summon a Rush Token.
(1) Cat Cafe: Summon a Felinor Token.
(1) Ping: Pierce. Deal {ping} damage.
(2) Witness Value: Discover a Unit.
(2) Stitching: Discover two ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.
(1) Armor Up: Your hero gains {armor} Armor until your next turn.
(2) Die Insect: Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.
(2) KY Brainstorm: Add a random KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).
(2) Pluck: Add a random Fruit to your hand. It costs ({fruitCost}).
(3) Terminus Tricks: Discover a Trap to summon.

radiant.text:
Indestructible
Start of game: Gain one of 13 random powers. Each is an Activate that spends its (X).
(3) Expedition Map: Recruit a permanent. Make it Radiant.
(1) Life Tap: Draw {tapDraw} from each player's deck.
(1) Steady Shot: Deal {shot} damage to the enemy hero. Upgrade this permanently by +2 damage.
(2) Ranching: Summon a Radiant Rush Token.
(1) Cat Cafe: Summon a random Felinor.
(1) Ping: Pierce. Deal {ping} damage. If this kills a Unit, summon a Ghoul Token with its stats.
(2) Witness Value: Discover a Radiant Unit.
(2) Stitching: Discover two Radiant ({stitchCost}) Cost or less Units. Fuse them.
(1) Tank Up: Your hero gains {armor} Armor, then this power refreshes.
(2) Die Insect: Lucky 1. Deal {insect} damage to a random enemy.
(2) KY Brainstorm: Add a Radiant KY card to your hand. Reduce the cost of all Spells in your hand by ({discount}).
(2) Pluck: Add a random Radiant Fruit to your hand. It costs ({fruitCost}).
(3) Terminus Tricks: Discover a Radiant Trap to summon.

base.text: Cry: Your next Trap or Field Spell costs ({discount}) less.

radiant.text: Cry: Your next Trap or Field Spell costs ({setCost}).

base.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Exile {cards|card|cards} from it.

radiant.text: Look at your opponent's hand. Choose a cost. Exile every card of that cost from it.

base.text: Summon Units from your graveyard that cost ({budget}) or less in total. Exile this.

radiant.text: Summon every Unit from your graveyard. Exile this.

base.text: Reveals when a hit would bring your hero to 0 or less: Redirect the hit to the enemy hero. Then heal your hero {heal} and draw {draw}.

radiant.text: Reveals when a hit would bring your hero to 0 or less: Redirect the hit to the enemy hero. Then heal your hero {heal} and draw your deck.

base.text: Cry: Choose up to {spells|Spell|Spells} in your graveyard. Cast them, then exile them.

radiant.text: Cry: Cast every Spell in your graveyard, oldest first, then exile them.
Aura: Your opponent can't play ({threshold})+ Cost cards.

base.text:
Start of turn: Reveal.
Aura: Enemy Units have −X Attack, where X is {multiplier}× the number of Units your opponent controls.
When your opponent controls no Units, Tribute this.

radiant.text:
Start of turn: Reveal.
Aura: Enemy Units have 0 Attack.
When your opponent controls no Units, Tribute this.

base.text: Degrade {cards|random card|random cards} in your opponent's deck. Draw {draw}.

radiant.text: Degrade every card in your opponent's deck. Draw {draw}.
